_comment: Was a DESTROY_TOKEN naming no token at all. DESTROY_TOKEN destroys ONE token of a named slug the CONTROLLER controls, and returns immediately when the slug is empty -- so it destroyed nothing. It also fired on START_OF_TURN gated on IN_COMBAT, neither of which the card says: 'at the beginning of YOUR ACTION PHASE' is START_OF_ACTION_PHASE for the active player (CR 4.3.1), and the start phase happens earlier. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'Heroes can't draw cards during action phases' -- a draw-legality restriction on both players, which has no hook.
